content:
On the last step, were you gently pull the belt? if you pull too hard, the motor will jump up and you have to remove it and start over to make sure the belt is seated right

Place one hand on the motor to hold it in properly and then gently pull the belts with the other

When placing the motor mount on the rail, if One side of the belt is significantly longer, and pulling downward, it can rotate the belt out of place

What I found helpful is to drape the slack of the belt over the top of the printer

You could also place a small piece of tape to hold the belt onto the printer in such a way it wouldn’t rotate itself out of place
